metas.name: Khalifa: The Ruler
metas.description: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

metas.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
metas.description: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

metas.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
metas.description: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

metas.name: Super Sharanya
metas.description: Sharanya, an ordinary small-town girl from Palakkad, who moves to Thrissur for higher studies, finds herself changing as she meets Deepu.

metas.name: Drishyam 3
metas.description: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

metas.name: I'm Game
metas.description: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

metas.name: All We Imagine as Light
metas.description: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, tries in vain to find a spot in the city to be intimate with her boyfriend. A trip to a beach town allows them to find a space for their desires to manifest.

metas.name: Dridam
metas.description: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given only a week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

metas.name: Jenny
metas.description: Jenny, a young software professional from a coastal village in Kerala, returns home to spend a few days with her family before leaving for work. When a renovation forces her estranged grandfather back into her life, long-buried memories begin to resurface.

metas.name: Daveed
metas.description: A celebrity bodyguard finds himself in trouble when he crosses an infamous boxer.

metas.name: Unmadham
metas.description: Haunted by his past, a police constable reopens an unsolved cold case. As hidden secrets surface, he must confront truths that challenge his beliefs forever.

metas.name: Mollywood Times
metas.description: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

metas.name: Marco
metas.description: The adoptive son of the Adattu family, Marco, sets off on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his brother is brutally murdered, finding only betrayal, loss and unimaginable brutality at every step.

metas.name: The Goat Life
metas.description: Indian migrant worker Najeeb Muhammad goes to Saudi Arabia to earn money. However, in a twist of fate, he finds himself living a slave-like existence, herding goats in the middle of the desert.

metas.name: Bramayugam
metas.description: A folk singer in 17th-century Kerala discovers a mansion. Inside, he encounters an enigmatic cook and a powerful master, setting in motion a chain of events that changes his life.

metas.name: Balan - The Boy
metas.description: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

metas.name: Khalifa 2 : The Legacy
metas.description: A prequel to Khalifa: The Ruler that narrates the story of Mambarakkal Ahmed Ali and the events which led to him becoming a smuggler and crime-lord.

metas.name: I, Nobody
metas.description: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

metas.name: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
metas.description: Three Kerala Police officers venture into a mysterious forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border to find a missing officer. They encounter strange time-related phenomena, uncovering the hidden secrets of Velloorkkatt forest.

metas.name: Premalu
metas.description: Sachin, a carefree graduate, crosses paths with Reenu, a spirited IT professional, in Hyderabad. As their friendship deepens, unspoken feelings, career ambitions and life choices challenge their bond.

metas.name: Hello Dear
metas.description: A hello is just the beginning. The magic lies in everything that follows

metas.name: Rotten Society
metas.description: When a missing news reporter's camera resurfaces, it reveals fragments of a deadly political conspiracy, murder, and corruption hidden from the public. As the footage falls into the hands of a disturbed stranger who continues recording his own descent into chaos, the camera becomes a chilling witness to an escalating nightmare where truth is as dangerous as the people trying to bury it.

metas.name: Secret of Kalinga
metas.description: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.

metas.name: Kattalan
metas.description: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

metas.name: Athiradi
metas.description: Energetic student Samkutty revives a banned college festival, igniting a fierce rivalry that transforms celebration into chaos.

metas.name: Pallichattambi
metas.description: Set in the politically turbulent late 1950s, Krishnan Pillai, a playful ruffian chosen by the Church to lead a defensive force, the Christopher Sena. His mission to resist the Communist government takes a detour when he experiences an ideological awakening and falls in love with a comrade, sparking an epic tale of rebellion against feudal power and oppression.

metas.name: Oru Kochu Swapnam
metas.description: Sindhu  is a spoilt teenage girl living with her sister Sulochana and her brother-in-law Venu. She then moves into a hostel where her roommate is Sofia who is in a relationship with a music store owner who is of questionable character. Sindhu becomes intrigued by her sexual desires and falls for Sofia's boyfriend.

metas.name: Thudakkam
metas.description: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

metas.name: Bharathanatyam 2 Mohiniyattam
metas.description: The family's journey to Sreekandapuram to settle the late Bharathan Nair's second wife and son takes a dark turn when an issue from his past resurfaces, leading to an unexpected crime. Forced into a desperate cover-up to protect their future, the family must navigate a treacherous path of secrecy and mounting pressure, determined to overcome any obstacle by any means necessary.

metas.name: Avaraachan & Sons
metas.description: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

metas.name: Sarvam Maya
metas.description: An atheist priest's life is upended after performing an exorcism, bonding with a charming spirit who helps him pursue music and heal his past.

metas.name: Minnal Murali
metas.description: A tailor gains special powers after being struck by lightning but must take down an unexpected foe if he is to become the superhero his hometown in Kerala needs.

metas.name: Sumathi Valavu
metas.description: A haunted curve in 1990s Kerala, named after Sumathis tragic death, draws various people into supernatural encounters. As they experience strange events, the mystery of Sumathi and the roads dark history begins to unfold.

metas.name: Anomie
metas.description: Zaara, a relentless sister seeking answers in her brother's unresolved case, confronts a police officer after days of failed investigation. As faith in the system erodes, she pursues the truth on parallel paths, leading to a haunting revelation.

metas.name: Kurukkante Kalyanam
metas.description: Sivasubrahmania, a 32-year-old unhappy bachelor, shifts to another city in order to escape from his religious father. Desperate for affection, he falls in love with a girl 14 years younger than him.

metas.name: Patriot
metas.description: When a Malayali DRW analyst tries to expose a corrupt regional politician from Kerala and his malpractices regarding spyware, he goes on the run, becomes a vlogger, and must clear his name of the false allegations levelled against him.

metas.name: Sathyathil Sambhavichathu
metas.description: A long-standing legend speaks of treasure hidden beneath village ponds and wells, with only one man ever claiming to have found it. When clues about the lost treasure begin to surface, a series of misunderstandings, unexpected discoveries, and amusing consequences unfold, blending mystery with humor.

metas.name: Pandippada
metas.description: Bhuvana wishes to sell his land to clear his debts. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when he finds himself caught in the power battle between two landlords.

metas.name: Premam
metas.description: Three stages in George's life, and three girls he encounters in each stage.

metas.name: Vaazha II
metas.description: Four friends – Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak – are considered losers and troublemakers by parents, family and the school management. They face immense social pressure as they reach adulthood, embarking them on an emotional journey of self discovery and acceptance, where they finally learn to take up their responsibilities and find success.

metas.name: Rachel
metas.description: A butcher's daughter seeks violent revenge, fueled by loss and loyalty. Her brutal path intertwines with romance and conflict as she pursues justice.

metas.name: Vandae Maatharam
metas.description: Gopikrishnan and Anwar Hussain, two tough police officers, help resolve local issues. However, when terrorist activities run rampant in their hometown, they must step up to restore peace.
